messages:
Michelle (docs): quick heads-up — opened a tiny PR to clarify the KV cache TTL in the dashboard embed snippet. link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321
Sam (eng-runtime): thanks — will skim. is the TTL seconds or ms in the example? the comment says 'ms' in one place which confused me.
Jen (devex): ah that mismatch slipped by me during the initial copy. i think our console UI uses seconds everywhere else.
Michelle (docs): right now the snippet shows `ttl: 300` with a trailing comment `# ms` — that's the bug. intended to be seconds.
Olivia (product): is there any UX change incoming that would change the meaning here? dont want to land docs that become wrong after the UI tweak next week.
Sam (eng-runtime): no API change planned; we did discuss TTL granularity but decided on seconds for v1. if backend ever accepts ms we'll add explicit units in the API and update examples.
Michelle (docs): cool. PR updates: i changed the inline comment, added more explicit wording, and added a short note under the dashboard embed section. diff: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321/files
docs-bot: lint-check started for pull request #4321
Jen (devex): can you also add a tiny note about how TTL interacts with prefix/KV caching invalidation? people often expect it to be per-user but it is per-prefix. one line should do it.
Michelle (docs): good call — added: "TTL is applied per cache prefix; to scope caching per-user include user id in the prefix."
Sam (eng-runtime): looks good, left a couple of inline comments on wording. nothing blocking.
deploy-bot: CI: unit-tests passed, integration tests running (10m remaining)
Michelle (docs): pinging @Sam for the last review, and @Jen for one more copycheck. i want to get this in before the console release notes cut tomorrow.
Jen (devex): copycheck done, tiny nit on punctuation — fixed in a followup commit.
Sam (eng-runtime): approved. changed wording on the TTL paragraph to link to the API reference.
deploy-bot: CI finished: all checks passed
Michelle (docs): merging now. thanks all :tada:
Olivia (product): perfect — will reference the clarified snippet in the release notes.
Michelle (docs): noted for release notes: add link to the specific docs section and call out "TTL units clarified" under UX fixes.
Michelle (docs): (after merge) merged and pushed. closing the thread.
